thread:
ravi (sales): heads up — customer in highly isolated govt datacenter asked for a POC. They want a fully offline installer and predictable upgrade cadence. main asks: max bundle size, delta update story, license activation offline, and CVE/patch workflow. any red flags?
marie (solutions): ok. POC constraints: offline installer + detachable SBOM + signed bundles. we have two packaging forms: full image (~5.2GB gz) and delta patches (typically ~80-300MB depending on quantized models).
samir (eng-runtime): adding: model artifacts dominate size. for quantized 4-bit LLMs we push ~400-800MB per model in delta-friendly chunks. full bundle for runtime (not models) ~450MB.
ravi (sales): customer asked about upgrade cadence — they're regulated and only want monthly security fixes, major feature upgrades quarterly. can we support a locked cadence + opt-in feature releases?
marie (solutions): yes, we can ship security-only deltas between major quarterly windows. process: we do signed hotfix bundles (patch-only) that apply on top of the installed bundle without internet. ops-bot: deploy-bundles created: /releases/offline/patches/signed/<sha256>.tar
samir (eng-runtime): caveat: hotfixes touching kernel/driver or CUDA requires full image replacement. we can flag patches as "runtime-safe" or "replace-required". we'll provide an upgrade matrix.
ravi (sales): they also asked about offline license activation & audit. how does that work?
marie (solutions): we support license activation via offline challenge-response token. procedure: customer generates CSR on air-gapped host -> send to Redwood partner (signed response) -> apply license token. tokens are time-bounded and tied to installation fingerprint.
samir (eng-runtime): security questionnaire note: KMS integrations are supported via a bring-your-own-HSM flow. in offline setups we provide keywrap support and an enterprise agent that performs local envelope decryption. Ops will deliver HSM config docs.
ravi (sales): what's the CVE patch SLA for Dedicated/offline customers? they want answers for contract.
marie (solutions): SLA: critical CVE patches within 48-72 hours for hosted; for offline we commit notification within 48h and a signed patch within 7 business days (depends on reproducer & compatibility). can escalate to emergency signed hotfix with additional fees.
samir (eng-runtime): also highlight: patches touching model weights require retesting evals for quality/regression. we include regression report in the POC bundle when model deltas are shipped.
ravi (sales): any enterprise blockers we should pre-surface to procurement/security teams?
marie (solutions): list to pre-surface: (1) offline SBOM & signed bundles requirement, (2) license challenge/response lead time, (3) HSM/keywrap design and on-prem agent install window, (4) network firewall rules if they allow one-way egress for reporting (optional), (5) policy for forced major upgrades after EOL.
samir (eng-runtime): ops note: minimal disk req per node: 120GB free to accommodate swap + model cache; prefer 256GB for comfortable multi-model POCs. CPU baseline: 8 cores, and GPU drivers pinned to validated versions.
ravi (sales): ok — i'll draft the POC SOW with these items. can someone confirm the delta patch typical size estimate for quantized models? i need a number for procurement.
samir (eng-runtime): estimate: 100-350MB per model delta (quantized) depending on sharding. give procurement "<=400MB per model typical" to be conservative.
marie (solutions): i'll attach the offline packaging checklist to the SOW and include the signed bundle walkthrough + CSR steps. :thumbsup: \nravi (sales): perfect. i'll follow up with draft and tag legal for license T&Cs. thanks all.
ops-bot: uploaded: sources/internal/release-notes/offline-poc-checklist-v2.pdf
marie (solutions): cc @samir — pls add the upgrade matrix CSV to the shared drive before EOD.
samir (eng-runtime): done — /shared/upgrade-matrices/offline_poc_matrix_v1.csv
ravi (sales): closing loop — i'll send the proposal to the customer tomorrow morning.
